Melbourne SEO questions, answered Four of the most common questions Melbourne buyers ask before committing to an SEO retainer. How much does SEO cost in Melbourne? SEO retainers in Melbourne typically run $1,200 to $4,000+GST per month depending on competition, scope and the number of target keywords. Project-based audits start from around $1,500. How long does SEO take to work? Most Melbourne businesses see measurable ranking movement in 3 to 6 months for mid-competition keywords. Tougher keywords in law, finance or national online retail can take 9 to 12 months. Do you do local SEO for Melbourne suburbs? Yes. Local SEO covers your Google Business Profile, local directory listings, suburb-level landing pages, and review strategy so your business shows in the Google Maps results and local pack across your service area. Will you guarantee first-page rankings? No. No reputable SEO specialist promises rankings, because Google's algorithm is the only authority on that.
